sources.entry: Tracim - Collaborative Platform for team collaboration: file,threads,notes,agenda,etc. AGPL-3.0/LGPL-3.0/MIT Python

summary.one_liner: Tracim is a self-hostable collaboration platform combining file sharing and versioning, team messaging, task and project management, and knowledge documentation, organized into spaces.
summary.what_it_does: Tracim offers file sharing with versioning, team communication, and task and project management organized in spaces. The README also describes it as covering chat, drive, video calls, knowledge and documentation, logbooks, and templates, though those details are marketing-level and not elaborated. The interface is multilingual, with Arabic, English, French, German and Portuguese listed. The README says the stack is Python, React and PostgreSQL. A Docker image (algoo/tracim) can be run locally with SQLite as the database, with the web app exposed on a port you choose and data kept in mounted volumes. The default login is documented as admin@admin.admin.
use_cases: task and project management in shared spaces
notable: Spaces-based organization combining files, threads, notes, agenda and tasks
Multilingual interface (Arabic, English, French, German, Portuguese)
Docker image runs with SQLite for quick local testing
Distributed under four licenses per LICENSE.md
caveats: Docker images for the latest versions are only available to paying customers
README warns that development and release processes are under active rework (2026-01-14 notice)
Professional support requires paid subscription plans
summary.license: AGPL-3.0/LGPL-3.0/MIT (per metadata; README says four distinct licenses, see LICENSE.md)
